learn.consortium.link: Design a consortium (beta): plants that grow well together in your climate
climate.tropical.about: Warm in every month and no frost; the year turns on wet and dry seasons.
climate.subtropical.about: Hot, humid summers and mild winters with little frost, or mild highlands with a dry winter.
climate.mediterranean.about: Dry, warm to hot summers and mild, rainy winters.
climate.arid.about: Little rain, far less than the sun and wind dry out: deserts and steppes, hot or cold.
climate.temperate.about: Mild all year, with rain in every season, cool summers and light frosts.
climate.continental.about: Cold winters with lasting frost or snow, and warm to hot summers.
climate.boreal.about: Long, very cold winters and short, cool summers.
climate.title: What is your climate?
climate.lede: Pages that change with the climate show yours first and hide nothing. Your choice stays on this device.
home.consortium.title: Design a consortium
home.consortium.lede: A consortium is a group of plants that help each other. Choose your climate and where you garden, and get 6 to 12 plants that grow well together, from tall trees down to ground cover, with what each one does for the others.
home.consortium.note: A beta with three places so far: temperate and Mediterranean Europe, and tropical Central and South America.
